name: @pipeworx/mcp-epa-aqs

tools.name: aqs_list_parameters
tools.description: Look up the EPA AQS code lists the other tools in this pack need — pollutant parameter codes, parameter classes, states, counties, sites and monitoring agencies. Call this FIRST to turn "ozone" into 44201 or "North Carolina" into 37. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

list.description: Which list: "classes" (parameter groups), "parametersByClass" (needs pc), "states", "countiesByState" (needs state), "sitesByCounty" (needs state + county), "cbsas", "pqaos", "mas"

pc.description: Parameter class, e.g. "CRITERIA", "AQI POLLUTANTS", "ALL" — required for parametersByClass

state.description: Two-digit state FIPS, e.g. "37" for North Carolina

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

tools.name: aqs_sample_data
tools.description: Raw measured air-pollutant sample values from EPA AQS for a date range — the regulatory record, by site, county, state or CBSA. AUTHORITATIVE for "what was the actual ozone/PM2.5/lead concentration here on these dates"; this is the quality-assured archive, not the provisional real-time AQI. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

param.description: Pollutant parameter code(s), comma-separated, max 5. e.g. "44201" (ozone), "88101" (PM2.5), "42401" (SO2), "14129" (lead)

bdate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (converted to the AQS YYYYMMDD form for you)

edate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD — must be in the SAME calendar year as bdate

state.description: Two-digit state FIPS — required for by=state/county/site

county.description: Three-digit county FIPS — required for by=county/site

site.description: Four-digit site number — required for by=site

cbsa.description: Five-digit CBSA code — required for by=cbsa

limit.description: Max sample rows to return (default 200, max 2000)

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

tools.name: aqs_annual_summary
tools.description: EPA AQS annual summary statistics for a pollutant and area — arithmetic mean, maximum, 98th/99th percentile, exceedance counts, observation completeness and the certification status behind each. This is what attainment and trend statements are built on. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

param.description: Pollutant parameter code(s), comma-separated, max 5, e.g. "44201"

edate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD — same calendar year as bdate

limit.description: Max summary rows to return (default 200, max 2000)

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

tools.name: aqs_monitors
tools.description: EPA AQS monitor metadata for an area — which pollutants are measured where, by which agency, with what method and network membership (NCore, PAMS, SLAMS), the monitoring objective, and each monitor's open and close dates. Use it to find the site codes aqs_sample_data needs and to check whether a place is monitored at all. Sourced from the EPA Air Quality System. Requires an EPA AQS email + key.

param.description: Pollutant parameter code(s), comma-separated, max 5, e.g. "44201"

edate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD — same calendar year as bdate

limit.description: Max monitor rows to return (default 200, max 2000)

email.description: The email the AQS key was issued to, if not folded into _apiKey

_apiKey.description: EPA AQS credential as "<email>:<key>", or just "<key>" with email= set. Register at https://aqs.epa.gov/data/api/signup?email=<your-email>

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-epa-aqs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the epa-aqs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
